rules.rule: orders.order_date <= shipments.shipped_date OR shipments.shipped_date IS NULL
rules.description: Ensures a shipment cannot be dispatched before the order is created.

impact.reason: Incorrect shipping dates can cause customer dissatisfaction and logistics failures.

rules.rule: orders.items_subtotal = (SELECT SUM(order_items.line_amount) FROM order_items WHERE order_items.order_id = orders.order_id) AND orders.total_amount = orders.items_subtotal + orders.shipping_fee - orders.order_discount
rules.description: Validates that the items subtotal matches the sum of line amounts and that the final total amount is correctly derived.

impact.reason: Financial miscalculations affect revenue reporting and customer billing.

rules.description: Prevents a payment record from being dated earlier than its corresponding order.

impact.reason: Payments recorded before orders indicate data entry or integration errors.

rules.description: Requires cancelled orders to have a refunded payment status.

impact.reason: Failure to refund cancelled orders leads to compliance and customer trust issues.

rules.rule: (order_items.order_id = orders.order_id AND order_items.product_id = products.product_id) AND (products.discontinued_date IS NULL OR orders.order_date <= products.discontinued_date)
rules.description: Ensures no orders are placed for products after their discontinuation date.

impact.reason: Selling discontinued items can breach contracts and cause inventory mismatches.

rules.description: Verifies that a customer cannot place an order before signing up.

impact.reason: Chronological inconsistencies may indicate data loading or identity errors.

rules.rule: NOT (orders.order_status = 'DELIVERED' AND (shipments.shipment_status <> 'DELIVERED' OR shipments.delivered_date IS NULL))
rules.description: Confirms that a delivered order has a corresponding shipment marked delivered with a delivery date.

impact.reason: Mismatched delivery status can result in inaccurate fulfillment reporting and customer disputes.
